name: Flip chart
summary: Flip chart on a tripod easel with a paper pad of boxes and arrows; anim flip folds the top sheet over.

params.name: y
params.note: floor point under the easel centre (1 m ~ 560 px)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the easel is about 500 px wide and 900 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: flip = the top sheet folds up over its hinge, then rests

author: krakujs
